title: the clearance gate names a human-proved piece's quorum validation
intention: ClearanceGate.crossing_of adds 'validation': validation_of(wf, proven_by), which, for a class _is_human_proved reads true and a ticket standing at PROVEME, returns validations_path_for_artifact of the first piece the crossings named whose seal is on disk (relative pieces tried under repo then commons); None otherwise.
why: 2026-11-12: sail.py cross 0682e51ab011 (concept-piece at PROVEME, quorum seal at CairnCommons/tickets/validations/0682e51ab011-batch-measured.json) refused: 'this node is human-proved (quorum signature gate) and the seal the crossing names does not prove it — the crossing names no validation'. gate.py's door called clear(workflow, to, boat_id, proven_by, **kw) and nothing in kw named one.
traces_to: Law 8 (a human-proved piece is proved by its quorum seal; the seat must be able to read it) and outline 9.6 (the crossing is asked at the gate with the fileref only).
how: ClearanceGate.crossing_of adds 'validation': validation_of(wf, proven_by), which, for a class _is_human_proved reads true and a ticket standing at PROVEME, returns validations_path_for_artifact of the first piece the crossings named whose seal is on disk (relative pieces tried under repo then commons); None otherwise. queueme's door passes validation= to clear only when it is set. Proof proofs/test_the_gate_names_a_quorum_validation.py over a scratch world with clear patched.

clauses.claim: a concept-piece standing at PROVEME whose named piece has a seal beside it crosses with validation= that seal's path
a code-seam crossing out of PROVEME is handed no validation
a concept-piece whose named piece has no seal on disk is handed no validation, and the quorum seat refuses it in its own words

decisions.text: D1: crossing_of carries validation from validation_of; queueme's door sets kw['validation'] only when it is set.
D2: the proof copies test_the_gate_crosses_with_the_askers_hand.py's scratch world, patches clearance.clear and gate.proven_by, one tooth per clause.

The hollow worktree has no CairnCommons beside it, so load_class_def read no class and every tooth redded at HEAD; the proof now points the class table at the home checkout when no sibling exists, the fallback test_a_ticket_queues_itself_at_a_gate.py already carries. Predicted in a bare worktree: green at HEAD, tooth 1 red with gate.py reverted.

out: transitions._quorum_gate and crossing_quorum (the seat reads what it is handed)
